notes: Fair dice and games. New 🎲 Dice button under the message box, or type the commands anywhere in a message: /roll 3d6+2, /d20, /flip, /card 5, /rps paper, /pick tea or coffee, /8ball. The result is truly random, shows right in your message, and the story has to go with it. When something in a scene comes down to luck for the characters (a dice game, a coin toss, a raffle), the story now uses real random rolls too instead of picking whatever it likes.
